description: Error classification, retry budget, and stop conditions for Phase 3 UI automation

types.description: Schema invalid, missing references, fixture-state mismatch
Build failure, type error, adapter mapping error, test assertion failure
Simulator unhealthy, process hang, DerivedData corruption, tool unavailable
types.special_rule: First occurrence: health check + cleanup, then retry once. Second failure: failed.

types.description: Implementation deviates from echo-memory-canvas, apple-native base, surface-family mapping, information hierarchy, or human intent
Protected path touched, real credentials requested, sensitive artifact produced, acceptance rule modification attempted

auto_retry_rules.no_blind_loop: Must change specific hypothesis or fix point; no identical re-run
auto_retry_rules.environment_special: Health check + cleanup before first retry; max 1 env retry
auto_retry_rules.on_exhaustion: failed — retain all artifacts, request human judgment

immediate_stop: Modify Core, data models, database migrations, or protected config
Guess domain rules or bypass existing Core interfaces
Request production signing, release credentials, real user data, or device wipe permission
Unapproved changes to contract, direction, or acceptance policy
Duplicate simulator owner or control conflict
Artifact contains credentials, PII, or unauthorized content
auto_fail: Two auto-retries exhausted on same phase
Environment error twice (after health check + one retry)

recovery_rules.after_env_timeout: Terminate related process groups; check residual processes, DerivedData, simulator, test state
recovery_rules.simulator_reuse: Only after environment health check passes
recovery_rules.product_divergence: Return to appropriate human approval point; do not fix with code micro-adjustments
recovery_rules.security_stop: Only authorized person may clear the cause and resume
